jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:

Job Description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company within the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the world's population, we play a critical role in the IT sales channel, connecting technology manufacturers and cloud providers with business-to-business technology experts worldwide

Key Responsibilities :

- Portfolio Strategy & Growth:
Drive revenue, margin, and market share across assigned SaaS vendors (Dropbox, DocuSign, Acronis, LogMeIn, etc.). Identify, evaluate, and onboard new SaaS vendors to expand the cloud portfolio. Unlock whitespace opportunities, new use cases, and cross-sell motions across new and existing partners.
- Program Management:
Execute vendor incentive programs, rebates, and partner promotions. Ensure timely campaign rollouts, strict adherence to program guidelines, and delivery against quarterly targets.
- Product Ownership:
Own the SaaS portfolio as a business line across traditional and marketplace models, including pricing strategy, SKU management, bundling, solution positioning, and go-to-market execution.
- Sales Enablement:
Enable internal sales teams and channel partners with structured trainings, pitch decks, competitive battle cards, and solution playbooks to accelerate SaaS adoption and upsell.
- Partner Development:
Recruit, onboard, and activate new partners. Drive partner productivity through structured engagement plans, certifications, and regular pipeline reviews.
- Stakeholder Engagement:
Serve as the primary interface between SaaS vendors (Dropbox, DocuSign, Acronis, etc.), internal sales, marketing, and operations teams. Align joint business plans with vendor account managers and partner development teams.
- Demand Generation & Marketing Alignment:
Partner with marketing to design and execute digital campaigns, webinars, and field initiatives to generate pipeline and improve conversion rates.
- Renewals & Customer Lifecycle Management:
Collaborate closely with the renewals team to review subscription trends, churn drivers, and expansion opportunities. Define retention, upsell, and cross-sell strategies and guide the renewal team for improved outcomes.
- Reporting & Forecasting:
Track and analyze KPIs including revenue, gross margin, attach rate, renewal rate, pipeline coverage, and partner contribution. Deliver periodic business reviews and accurate forecasts to leadership.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in IT or a related field; MBA is preferred.
- 5–6 years of experience in Cloud Sales, Business Management, or SaaS Portfolio Management.
- Strong understanding of the cloud ecosystem, channel distribution model, and overall cloud industry landscape.
- Good understanding of subscription and licensing models, consumption-based cloud models, API integrations, as well as data backup, security, and compliance concepts
- Proven ability to drive revenue growth, manage vendor relationships, and execute go-to-market strategies.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Certifications in Cloud technologies (SaaS, IaaS, or hyperscaler platforms) are an added advantage.

jobs.title: Sr Principal Product Manager, Unified Support & AI Experience
jobs.description:

Job Description:

Position Summary :
Ingram Micro is transforming support into a modern, AI-enabled global platform experience. We are looking for a visionary Senior Principal Product Manager to lead product strategy and roadmap execution for our Unified Support and AI Experience ecosystem. This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of AI transformation, customer experience, platform strategy, and operational scale. This role is ideal for a product leader who has successfully transformed enterprise support experiences within large SaaS, cloud, platform, or marketplace organizations and who understands that great AI experiences are measured not only by efficiency gains, but also by customer trust, usability, and human outcomes. You won’t inherit a static roadmap.

You’ll help define the future direction.

Why This Role Matters:
This is a rare builder opportunity to help define the future of AI-enabled support within one of the world’s largest technology distribution and platform companies. You’ll join a transformation already in motion, with executive visibility, mature AI initiatives already in production, and the opportunity to shape how AI and human expertise work together to deliver world-class support experiences globally.
Responsibilities:
- Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Unified Support globally.
- Lead AI transformation initiatives across chat, voice, self-service, claims, returns, and agent-assist experiences.
- Drive automation and intelligent workflow orchestration across high-volume support operations.
- Partner with Engineering, AI/ML, Operations, and CX leaders to deliver scalable platform capabilities.
- Build seamless omnichannel support experiences across customer, partner, vendor, and associate journeys.
- Influence executive stakeholders and bring strategic product vision — not just requirements gathering.
- Measure success through KPIs such as self-service adoption, containment, MTTR, ticket reduction, and CSAT.

What you bring to the role:
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
- 8+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, marketplace, or platform environments.
- Proven experience and able to build or scale unified support or customer experience platforms on a global scale.
- Strong AI transformation experience with production-level implementations.
- Experience with technologies such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, Salesforce, NICE, Netomi, or similar platforms.
- Deep understanding of conversational AI, intelligent automation, agentic workflows, and self-service ecosystems.
- Executive presence with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to balance AI-driven efficiency with customer experience and human outcomes.

Sr. Product Manager – Subscriptions, Orders, & Exceptions Management
Ingram Micro is the business behind the world’s brands, providing more ways to realize the promise
of technology®. We are an integral part of the technology ecosystem, helping our partners grow and
thrive through the creation and delivery of Information Technology, Cloud solutions and Lifecycle services. With more than $54 billion in revenue and the ability to reach 90% of the global population,

We are one of the world’s largest technology distributors, serving our partners through operations in
61 countries with 29,000 associates.

Ingram Micro has earned Great Place to Work Certification TM for 2022-2023 in the United States! This prestigious recognition reflects our commitment to our people and our culture.

Come join our team where you’ll make technology happen in surprising ways. Let’s shape tomorrow -
It’ll be a fun journey!

The role:
Sr. Product Manager, Global Product Management
We are seeking a Sr. Product Manager to own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for our Subscriptions, Orders & Exceptions Management platform. This role will focus on delivering seamless post-sales experiences for software, licenses, warranties, subscriptions, and recurring services, while driving automation, reducing operational complexity, and improving customer and associate experiences.

The Sr. Product Manager will partner closely with Engineering, UX, Operations, Customer Success, Sales, and regional business teams to build scalable platform capabilities that simplify subscription lifecycle management, automate exception handling, and modernize the overall order management experience.

- Own the product roadmap and execution for Subscriptions, Orders & Exceptions Management, with a focus on software, licenses, warranties, and recurring services.
- Partner with customers, operations, engineering, UX, and regional business teams to identify pain points and deliver scalable product solutions.
- Define product requirements, write user stories, prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery from concept through production.
-  Build platform capabilities that simplify subscription lifecycle management, improve post-sales experience, and automate order and subscription exceptions.
- Analyze customer feedback, operational metrics, and exception trends to continuously improve product adoption, automation, and efficiency.
- Develop deep domain expertise and partner closely with operational stakeholders to create technology-enabled solutions to support Ingram Micro’s growth strategy.
- Create and execute innovative and automated features and products that can scale globally.
- Provide product leadership to Engineering, Business, and UX teams to help design and launch our next generation Platform ecosystem.
- Produce sustainable capabilities that can be reused with minimal effort and provide comprehensive documentation and training for users.
- Develop and maintain a technology roadmap and regularly update key partners and stakeholders, working closely with senior stakeholders across Ingram Micro to ensure vision aligns with broader company objectives.
- Work on multiple parallel work streams in fast-paced, agile environments, align them with business priorities & deadlines and help continuously raise the bar on execution.

What you bring to the role:
- 5-8 years of Product Management experience delivering enterprise software or SaaS products.
- A bachelor’s degree (master’s desirable) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related Science and Math discipline is preferred.
- Experience defining product roadmaps, managing Agile backlogs, and translating business needs into actionable product requirements.
- Strong understanding of subscription-based products, software licensing, warranties, order management, or post-sales business processes.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
- A customer-first mindset with a passion for simplifying complex workflows through intuitive product experiences and automation.
- Experience using data and customer insights to prioritize features, measure outcomes, and continuously improve products.
- Direct hands-on experience working with Engineering teams to clearly scope, define, detail and prioritize product requirements.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Commercial Team) - Hybrid
Senior Product Operations Analyst
jobs.location: Plainfield, IN, United States of America
jobs.description:
Accelerate your career. Join the organization that's driving the world's technology and shape the future.

Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts. Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com

Come join our team where you’ll make technology happen in surprising ways. Let’s shape tomorrow - it’ll be a fun journey!
Senior Product Operations Analyst

Position Overview

Ingram Micro is seeking a Senior Product Operations Analyst to serve as the analytical engine behind Product Operations. This role is responsible for building the financial, operational, and reporting foundation that enables Product Operations to operate as a portfolio of programs rather than individual projects.

The Senior Product Operations Analyst partners with Product Ops leadership, Engineering, Finance and Warehouse Operations teams to develop cost models, profitability reporting, KPI dashboards, and decision-support analytics. Success in this role requires strong business analysis skills, financial acumen, and the ability to convert complex data into actionable recommendations that improve operational performance and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Cost Management & Profitability Reporting
- Partner with Product Ops leadership to design, implement, and maintain costing methodologies.
- Analyze and manage key cost drivers, including labor, materials, freight, and other costs.
- Develop and maintain work-center burden rates, allocation methodologies, and cost models.
- Monitor labor reporting, throughput metrics, and operational data to ensure costing accuracy and consistency.
- Deliver profitability reporting and analysis that improves visibility into product, process, and program performance.

Program Financial Management
- Develop and maintain program-level financial reporting across Product Ops.
- Analyze revenue, cost, margin, and ROI performance to identify key drivers and improvement opportunities.
- Build business cases, forecasts, and financial models to support investment and operational decisions.
- Contribute to business reviews, prioritization discussions, and implementation planning through analytical and financial insights.

Business Intelligence & KPI Governance
- Partner with Product Operations leadership and program owners to define KPIs and operational performance metrics.
- Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into financial and operational performance.
- Establish standardized KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and governance practices.
- Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and integrity across operational and financial reporting.

Required Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Analytics, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in Cost Accounting, Manufacturing Finance, FP&A, Operations Finance, Business Analysis, or related discipline.
- Experience developing and maintaining cost models, standard costing methodologies, and WMS/ERP system management.
- Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI.
- Experience building financial models, business cases, forecasts, and ROI analyses.
- Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting automation.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
- Proven ability to partner effectively with Operations, Finance, and cross-functional business leaders.

Preferred Skills

- Experience supporting manufacturing, refurbishment, reverse logistics, supply chain, distribution, or technology operations environments.
- Experience developing KPI frameworks and operational performance reporting.
- Experience with SQL, Power Query, Power Automate, or similar analytics tools.
- Experience implementing automated reporting and self-service business intelligence solutions.
- Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence experience.
- Experience supporting program management, change management, or cross-functional business initiatives.

The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $78,000.00 - $124,800.00 per year.

The ranges above reflect the potential annual base pay across the U.S. for all roles; the applicable base pay range will depend on the candidate’s primary work location, pay grade, and variable compensation plan. Individual base pay within each range depends on various factors, in addition to primary work location, such as complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. At Ingram Micro certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, annual bonus or sales incentives and long-term incentives. These awards are allocated based on position level and individual performance. U.S.-based employees have access to healthcare benefits, paid time off, parental leave, a 401(k) plan and company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and wellbeing benefits, among others.

jobs.title: AI Enablement - Technical Program Manager (Consultant, Program Management)
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description:
Shape the Future of AI at Ingram Micro
At Ingram Micro, we're helping businesses realize the promise of technology by delivering innovative solutions that power growth, transformation, and opportunity around the world. As a global technology leader, we connect people, technology, and business outcomes at scale, creating meaningful impact for customers, partners, and communities.

Our AI Center of Excellence plays a critical role in this journey, bringing together business, product, engineering, data, and platform teams to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that drive measurable value.
We believe the best innovations come from diverse perspectives, strong collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. Guided by our Tenets of Success, Results, Integrity, Imagination, Courage, Responsibility, and Talent, we foster an inclusive culture where individuals are empowered to learn, grow, challenge what's possible, and make an impact. Together, we're shaping the future of technology and creating opportunities for our people to do the best work of their careers.

What You'll Do: Your Role in Making an Impact
As an AI Enablement Technical Program Manager (Consultant, Program Management), you will lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic enterprise AI programs, helping transform innovative ideas into scalable solutions that deliver meaningful business outcomes. Reporting to the Program Manager Lead, you will serve as the bridge connecting business stakeholders, product teams, AI engineering, development, data engineering, and platform teams to ensure successful execution across multiple initiatives.

In this role, you will define program roadmaps, establish milestones and success measures, and guide the prioritization of AI use cases aligned to organizational goals. You will drive cross-functional coordination, manage risks and dependencies, and maintain alignment between technical delivery and business value realization. You will oversee the deployment of enterprise AI and Agentic AI solutions, ensuring adherence to best practices across model lifecycle management, monitoring, governance, and operational excellence. Additionally, you will provide executive-level visibility into program progress, support organizational adoption of AI capabilities, and help ensure all solutions meet Responsible AI, security, and data privacy standards. Your contributions will directly influence how Ingram Micro scales AI innovation across the business.

What You Bring to the Role: Professional Experience & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
- Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience in Technical Program Management, technology delivery, or a similar leadership role managing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
- Proven success delivering large-scale technology, AI/ML, data platform, or digital transformation programs from concept through production deployment. - Strong understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including GenAI, data pipelines, model lifecycle management, and enterprise AI delivery practices.
- Experience leading enterprise AI, machine learning, or data platform programs at scale.
- Familiarity with MLOps practices, model monitoring, retraining frameworks, and AI governance standards.
- Exposure to Agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, automation platforms, or intelligent workflow solutions.

- Experience working within Agile, Scrum, hybrid, or large-scale enterprise delivery environments.
- Experience working with cloud-based platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or similar environments.
- Certification or formal training in Project Management, Agile, Scrum, SDLC, or related methodologies is highly valued.
